## Description

**What**: Update existing project documentation to reflect the new config keys, dispatcher pattern, merge/enforcement strategy defaults, and behavior changes introduced by this epic.
**Why**: Without documentation updates, future agents and users will reference stale information (hardcoded phase lists, direct-only merge assumptions, missing config key documentation).
**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md (architecture section, quick reference table); CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (new config keys merge.strategy and enforcement.strategy); WORKTREE-GUIDE.md (dispatcher pattern and --strategy flag); INSTALL.md (PR-mode setup instructions); KNOWN-ISSUES.md if relevant issues surfaced during implementation
- OUT: Creating new documentation files or patterns; implementation changes (all implementation is in S1-S7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md architecture section and quick reference table reflect the dispatcher pattern, new config keys, and PR/direct mode phase differences
  <- Satisfies: "This project's dso-config.conf is updated within this epic" (narrative documentation)
- When this story is complete, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents merge.strategy and enforcement.strategy keys with defaults, valid values, and behavior descriptions
  <- Satisfies: "Config keys merge.strategy (direct|pr, default direct) and enforcement.strategy (local|ci|both, default local) introduced"
- When this story is complete, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md merge-to-main.sh references are updated to reflect the dispatcher pattern and the --strategy flag
  <- Satisfies: implied residual references from consumer audit
- When this story is complete, INSTALL.md includes PR-mode setup instructions for projects using merge.strategy=pr
  <- Satisfies: "updates to onboarding / installer / template defaults"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting, structure, and conventions

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect PR-merge mode and enforcement-strategy config
